actions.name: Use
actions.effect: one creature afflicted with Frozen status effect

description.summary: The target for this spell requires the Frozen status effect to be in effect.
description.value: The target for this spell requires the Frozen status effect to be in effect. Once you cast this spell, the Frozen status effect is removed and a burst of slick ice explodes centered on the target in a 10- ft.- radius burst that lasts for 1 round. Any creature in the area when the spell is cast must make a successful Reflex save or fall. A creature can walk within or through the area of slick ice at half normal speed with a DC 10 Acrobatics check. Failure means it can’t move that round (and must then make a Reflex save or fall), while failure by 5 or more means it falls (see the Acrobatics skill for details). Creatures that do not move on their turn do not need to make this check and are not considered flat-footed. In addition, the ice hampers the creatures’ movements, reducing movement speed by 5 feet until they escape the ice.
